scholarships.title: Future African Leader Scholarship
scholarships.funding_label: Fully Funded (full tuition up to two years plus a NOK 50,000 per semester living-expense stipend)

existing.description: The Future African Leader Scholarship is one of two MSc scholarships BI offers to support its membership of the GBSN Network and GMAC's Study in Europe Initiative, specifically for candidates in Africa. Each award covers full tuition fees for up to two years plus a stipend for living expenses of NOK 50,000 per semester, conditional on meeting the academic progression requirements. Applicants must be international citizens who are not residents of Norway, hold a minimum overall GPA of 4.0 on the ECTS scale, submit strong GMAT or GRE scores, and be admitted to the first year of an MSc programme at the Oslo or Bergen campus; preference goes to candidates from a GBSN member school in Africa or African citizens who attended a GMAC Study in Europe event. The deadline is 1 March and results are notified by the end of April.
eligibility: Preference for candidates currently enrolled at or recently graduated from a GBSN Member School in Africa, or candidates with African citizenship who participated in a GMAC Study in Europe event online or in person in Africa
International citizenship and not a resident of Norway, with a strong academic record
Strong GMAT or GRE test scores as required for admission
Minimum overall GPA of 4.0 on the ECTS scale, with international grades converted by BI
Admission to the first year of a Master of Science degree programme at campus Oslo or campus Bergen, except the BI-Luiss Joint Masters in Marketing
Only candidates seeking their first master's degree are considered
existing.eligibility_summary: International citizens who are not residents of Norway with a minimum overall GPA of 4.0 on the ECTS scale and strong GMAT or GRE scores, admitted to the first year of an MSc programme at BI's Oslo or Bergen campus. Preference is given to candidates from a GBSN member school in Africa or African citizens who attended a GMAC Study in Europe event.
benefits: Full tuition fees for up to two years
NOK 50,000 per semester stipend for living expenses
coverage: Full tuition fees for up to two years
Stipend for living expenses of NOK 50,000 per semester
No travel, housing or insurance coverage stated
requirements: Apply for the scholarship at the same time as the admission application on BI's online portal
State in the scholarship letter that you are enrolled at or a graduate of a GBSN member school, or identify the GMAC Study in Europe event you attended with date and place
Upload the combined CV and letter to the section marked 'Scholarship'
Accept the offer of admission for the scholarship application to be considered
No documentation submitted after the application will be accepted
Maintain 30 ECTS per semester and a cumulative GPA of at least 'B' on the BI ECTS scale
documents: Scholarship application letter of a maximum one page, combined with the CV into a single PDF, which must identify either enrolment at or graduation from a GBSN member school or the GMAC Study in Europe event attended with date and place
All documentation required for admission evaluation to an MSc programme
application_method: Scholarship materials are uploaded to the 'Scholarship' section of the same online application used for admission. Applications for scholarship are not accepted by email.
existing.selection_notes: Awarded on academic merit, not financial need, assessed on the ECTS scale with international grades converted by BI. Two MSc scholarships are offered in support of BI's GBSN Network and GMAC Study in Europe Initiative memberships. Applicants are also considered for the BI Presidential Scholarship, the MSc International Scholarship and the Women in Finance and Tech Scholarship where applicable, and for other BI-sponsored scholarships except the A. Wilhelmsen Foundation Scholarship and the BI-Luiss Joint Masters in Marketing. Decisions are final and cannot be appealed.
existing.best_fit: African master's applicants with strong academic and leadership profiles at BI
existing.duration: Up to two years of full tuition fees plus a per-semester stipend
existing.application_period: Annual: scholarship materials uploaded with the admission application before 1 March; results notified by the end of April. Two MSc scholarships are offered.
existing.deadline_display: Application deadline is March 1. International and domestic applicants must upload a complete application for admission, including the scholarship application, to the online application portal. Applications for scholarship are not accepted by email. Late applications will not be considered.
